meta.title: Aten Hotep
meta.author: Skyrunner (Brain Control)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Aten Hotep by Brain Control (April 2019). Brain Control's 64K intro that placed 5th in the PC 64K intro competition at Revision 2019. Music by Skyrunner (credited in the intro's readme and pouet), made with Tunefish 4, Brain Control's own synthesizer. 125 BPM, 2:30, 12 tracks, 2458 notes. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the Tunefish 4 song (.tfm) was read from the running executable's memory (tools/tf-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert tfm` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64 with its insert effects as track devices, kinds 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the upstream Tunefish 4 player it differs by +0.03 dB loudness and at most 1.48 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz; the random per-voice detune GenSlop is not converted and the wavetable phases come from a different random sequence. Track names are derived here from each track's notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors (Tunefish 4 itself is GPL-3.0, which does not cover songs made with it). It is published here as an adapted reference copy while Brain Control is asked for permission, and is removed at the authors' request.
